chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Abdullah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

key_terms.اَلْإِيقَاعُ: Consummation or effecting the marriage act

ai.seo_question: What constitutes consummation of marriage in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Shaykh al-Tusi records this concise ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) linking physical intimacy directly to the legal concept of consummation (*iqa'*), which triggers financial obligations like the full dowry (*sadaq*). This narration is pivotal in Shia jurisprudence for defining the threshold of marital completion, distinguishing it from mere engagement or preliminary contact, thereby clarifying the wife's right to her full share of the mahr upon such union.
